build_hf_gpt2_model: build a HuggingFaceGPT2LanguageModel instance using build_model with args and task
build_hf_gpt2_decoder: build a HuggingFaceGPT2Decoder with GPT2Config and GPT2LMHeadModel from transformers
run_gpt2_forward: run the forward pass on prev_output_tokens to get language model logits
extract_gpt2_features: extract features from prev_output_tokens using the GPT2 transformer with incremental state
configure_gpt2_architecture: configure a GPT2 architecture variant like hf_gpt2_medium or hf_gpt2_large
